records.title: Co-Inference Over Wireless Multi - Hop Networks
records.reason: The primary DOI/publisher endpoint was inaccessible and the search returned metadata/abstract rather than the paper body. Abstract proposes multi-splitting DNN computation over wireless multi-hop nodes with joint route/split/deployment optimization and early exits. This is edge inference/offloading but not specifically language models; method/evaluation scope could not be checked.
